an4.42:1.1: “There are these four ways of answering questions.
an4.42:1.3: There are questions that should be answered categorically [straightforwardly yes, no, this, that].
an4.42:1.4: There are questions that should be answered with an analytical answer [defining or redefining the terms].
an4.42:1.5: There are questions that should be answered with a counter-question.
an4.42:1.6: There are questions that should be put aside.
an4.42:1.7: These are the four ways of answering questions.”
an4.42:2.3: third, the type to be counter-questioned,
an4.42:2.4: & fourth, the one to be put aside.
an4.42:3.1: Any monk who knows which is which,
an4.42:3.4: in the four types of questions:
an4.42:4.1: hard to overcome, hard to beat,
an4.42:4.2:
profound, hard to defeat.
